comment: 上限（GCN 31294：MASTER-IAC robotic telescope located in Spain (IAC Teide Observatory) was pointed to the Swift GRB 211223C errorbox 54769 sec after trigger time at 2021-12-24 05:42:16 UT, with upper limit up to 16.4 mag）；原文表行 Tmid-T0=54860 | MASTER-IAC | C | 180 | 16.4；C=clear 无滤光片、原文未给波段口径，band=G（2026-10-12 裁定）；原文未声明星等系统，mag_system 留空；time 取指向时刻 2021-12-24 05:42:16 UT + 90 s（单张 180 s 曝光中点）=05:43:46 UT，由 05:43:46 UT − T0(14:29:26.700140) 反算得 54859.29986 s，与原文表 Tmid-T0=54860 s（整秒口径）自洽；time_err=90 s（半曝光）；mjd 由 T0+time 换算；未做银河系消光改正；观测条件（GCN 31294）：The galactic latitude b = 26 deg., longitude l = 338 deg.；The observations began at zenith distance = 82 deg.；The sun altitude is -27.6 deg.
